text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A magazine nominates Sakura Bakushin O as "The People's Favorite Sprinter." As she intends to run in the Classic Triple Crown, she is less than pleased.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At this stage, stepping away from sprints would net her little results.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I decide that based on the results at the Spring Stakes, she can spend the year running many sprints, taking advantage of her forte in speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, struck by my passionate words, displays a greater interest towards the Spring Stakes.
